title: Field service SaaS
summary: Project tracking, reporting workflows and real-time dashboards for field-service businesses.
problem: Field-service businesses needed robust tools for project tracking, reporting and task automation.
solution: Built field-service automation features, custom reporting workflows and performance-focused Node.js APIs, with MySQL storage optimised for fast retrieval and real-time Angular dashboards.
result: Made report generation 50% faster and improved overall platform stability.
